label: Customer API
description: The customer registry's REST API: GET /customer, GET /customer/{id}, POST /customer, PUT /customer/{id}, DELETE /customer/{id}. A missing id answers 404 with the JSON string "Not found". Requests against it are paced: at most four in flight at once and at most three started in any one second, so a batch removal and the backfill, which each issue one request per row, stay within what a public API will take.
